It did not spawn naturally, and was instead spawned by the [[Splitter (Polluted Wasteland)|Splitter]] upon its death. This enemy was much faster than the [[Splitter (Polluted Wasteland)|Splitter]], but was also weaker than it. In addition, upon its death, the '''Split''' stunned towers within a small radius. ==Appearance== The '''Split's''' appearance was similar to the [[Splitter (Polluted Wasteland)|Splitter]], but was much smaller. It had light blue skin and a large bloated stomach. Its navel was blue. It wore black shorts and has grey legs. Its eyes were white, and a radioactive substance leaked out of its eyes and mouth. ==Strategy== *The [[Rocketeer]] and [[Mortar]] are recommended against the '''Split''' as they spawn in pairs. *You can use the [[Medic]]'s ability to cleanse towers from their stun after a [[Splitter (Polluted Wasteland)|Splitter]]'s death to attack the '''Split'''. *As the '''Split''' moves very quickly, they can run past your towers if you aren't careful. **For this reason, the [[Military Base]] can be quite useful against this [[Enemies|enemy]] as [[units]] cannot be stunned by the '''Split'''. *You can use the [[Frost Blaster]], [[Freezer]] and [[Electroshocker]] to slow the '''Split''' down. ==Trivia== *This is closely related to the [[Swarm]], an [[Enemies|enemy]] that appeared before the [[Release v1.0|MEGA Update]], as it was also spawned by another enemy upon death, the [[Carrier]]. *Weirdly, its legs are the same as the ones used by the second version of the [[Tank]]. *This enemy was effectively replaced by the [[Goo]] in [[Polluted Wasteland II]], as both have very similar mechanics. ==Update History== *'''29 April 2020''' - [[Release v1.10|Release v1.10.0]] **'''Split''' added. *'''29 October 2020''' - [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul v1.0.0]] **[[Partial Electric Immunity]] replaced with [[Energy Immunity]]. **No longer appears in Golden mode as it has been removed. *'''8 May 2021''' - [[Overhaul v1.3|Overhaul v1.3.0]] **'''Split''' removed. {{ZombieNavBox}} [[Category:Polluted Wasteland]] {{DISPLAYTITLE:Split}}
